cases.title: Pregnancy Checklist for Families
cases.summary: To manage your pregnancy in Espoo, you must schedule appointments at your local maternity clinic and submit required applications to Kela for the maternity grant and pregnancy allowance. You are also responsible for notifying your employer of your upcoming pregnancy leave in writing.

steps.detail: Contact a maternity clinic in your area in Espoo to book your first appointment.

steps.title: Apply for maternity grant from Kela
steps.detail: Apply for the maternity grant from Kela at least two months before your estimated due date.
steps.due: at least two months before the child’s due date

steps.title: Notify employer of pregnancy leave
steps.detail: Give your employer written notice of your pregnancy leave at least two months before the leave starts.
steps.due: no later than two months before the start of your leave

steps.title: Apply for pregnancy allowance from Kela
steps.detail: Apply for pregnancy allowance from Kela after your pregnancy has reached 154 days, no later than two months after the leave starts.

cases.title: Checklist for Pregnancy
cases.summary: You need to contact your local maternity clinic for monitoring, notify your employer of your pregnancy leave, and apply for maternity grant and pregnancy allowance through Kela after your pregnancy has lasted at least 154 days. Employers must be notified of leaves well in advance, and Kela applications have specific deadlines tied to your pregnancy progress.

steps.title: Notify employer of pregnancy leave
steps.detail: Notify your employer of your upcoming pregnancy leave no later than two months before it begins. Check your industry's collective agreement for specific notification requirements.
steps.due: no later than two months before the start of your leave

steps.title: Apply for maternity grant from Kela
steps.detail: Apply for the maternity grant through Kela after your pregnancy has lasted 154 days and you have received a pregnancy certificate.
steps.due: no later than two months before the expected date of birth of the child

steps.title: Apply for pregnancy allowance from Kela
steps.detail: Apply for pregnancy allowance through Kela once you have reached 154 days of pregnancy and have your pregnancy certificate. The allowance is paid for 40 working days.
steps.due: within 2 months of the start of your pregnancy leave at the latest

steps.title: Notify employer of work risk factors
steps.detail: If your work involves substances or conditions that endanger the pregnancy, inform your employer immediately to arrange safer work or take special pregnancy leave.

money.label: “As a rule, the employer must be notified of a pregnancy leave, parental leave or…”
money.amount: no later than two months before the start of the leave

money.label: “Kela pays pregnancy allowance for 40 working days regardless of the actual date of birth…”

cases.title: Handling an Unilateral Rent Increase
cases.summary: A landlord cannot unilaterally increase your rent unless your tenancy agreement includes a specific, pre-agreed clause for doing so. If they attempt to increase it, they are required to provide notice, and you have the right to dispute the increase in writing if it does not follow the terms of your contract.

steps.title: Check the required notice period for rent increases
steps.detail: The landlord must notify you of a rent increase two months in advance.

steps.title: Verify the rent increase clause in your agreement
steps.detail: A landlord cannot unilaterally raise the rent unless it was previously agreed upon in your tenancy agreement with a precise, unambiguous basis for the increase.

steps.title: Submit a written complaint to your landlord
steps.detail: If the increase is unjustified, submit a written complaint to your landlord immediately. You can use the Consumer and Market Authority's Complaint Assistant tool to draft this letter.

steps.title: Seek external dispute resolution if necessary
steps.detail: If the dispute remains unresolved, you can seek advice from Consumer Advisory Services or refer the matter to the Consumer Disputes Board.

money.label: Check the required notice period for rent increases

evidence.title: Housing - Oikeus.fi
evidence.quote: The lessee must always be notified of a rent increase two months in advance.

evidence.title: Paying the rent and rent raise - KKV
evidence.quote: The landlord does not have the right to increase the rent unilaterally during the tenancy.

evidence.title: Paying the rent and rent raise - KKV
evidence.quote: Claims should be submitted in written to the landlord.

evidence.title: Paying the rent and rent raise - KKV
evidence.quote: Consumers and private individuals acting as landlords may also refer the matter to the Consumer Disputes Board for assessment.

openQuestions: Does your tenancy agreement contain a specific rent increase clause?
Is the landlord a private person or a company?
Was your tenancy agreement concluded on or after 1 October 2026?

cases.title: Flight Cancellation Rights for Families
cases.summary: A family of three whose flight is cancelled is entitled to choose between a refund or re-routing and to receive care during the waiting period. You should request these options from the airline immediately and file a written complaint to seek potential standard compensation.

steps.title: Request refund or re-routing from airline
steps.detail: You must notify the airline if you choose to have your ticket refunded or re-routed instead of flying.

steps.title: Claim right to care during wait
steps.detail: The airline is obligated to provide care while you wait for your replacement flight.

steps.title: Claim standard compensation from airline
steps.detail: You may be entitled to standard compensation depending on flight distance and re-routing delay, unless the cancellation was due to extraordinary circumstances.

steps.title: File written complaint with airline
steps.detail: Submit a written complaint to the operating airline using their website contact form and include copies of your ticket and receipts.

steps.title: Request refund within seven days if applicable
steps.detail: If you choose to receive a refund for your ticket, the airline is required to pay it within seven days.

steps.title: Choose between ticket refund or re-routing
steps.detail: You can choose to either receive a ticket refund within seven days or accept an alternative re-routed flight to your destination.

money.label: “Standard compensation amounts vary from EUR 250 to EUR 600”

cases.title: Registering for unemployment
cases.summary: You must register as a jobseeker with your municipal employment services no later than your first day of unemployment to qualify for benefits. Once registered, apply for unemployment benefits from your fund or Kela after at least two weeks of unemployment.

steps.title: Register as a jobseeker
steps.detail: Register as a jobseeker through the Job Market Finland E-services. If you cannot use the online service or do not have a Finnish personal identity code, visit an Espoo Employment Services office in person.
steps.due: no later than your first day of unemployment

steps.title: Apply for unemployment benefits
steps.detail: Apply for unemployment benefit from your unemployment fund if you are a member, or from Kela if you are not. You can submit the application after you have been unemployed for at least two weeks.
steps.due: after you have been unemployed for at least two weeks

money.label: “You can get general social security benefit from Kela after you have been registered as…”

evidence.title: tyomarkkinatori.fi
evidence.quote: You can register as a job seeker before your unemployment or lay-off begins, but do so no later than on your first day of unemployment, because you can only receive unemployment benefits from the registration date.

evidence.title: I have been laid off - Situation-based information - Job Market Finland
evidence.quote: If you are laid off, register as a job seeker in the E-services at Job Market Finland no later than the first day of your lay-off period.

evidence.title: Registering as a jobseeker | City of Espoo
evidence.quote: Remember to register as a jobseeker no later than your first day of unemployment, as unemployment benefits can only be paid from the date of registration onwards.

evidence.title: If you become unemployed
evidence.quote: Apply for unemployment benefit from the unemployment fund or Kela after you have been unemployed for at least two weeks.

evidence.title: If you become unemployed | Our Services | Kela
evidence.quote: You can get general social security benefit from Kela after you have been registered as an unemployed jobseeker with the employment services for at least 7 working days.

openQuestions: Were you dismissed for financial or production-related reasons, or laid off?
Are you 55 years of age or older?
Are you a member of an unemployment fund?

cases.title: Moving house in Espoo checklist
cases.summary: Moving within Finland requires submitting an official change-of-address notification to the Digital and Population Data Services Agency and Posti. You must also terminate your current rental and utility agreements and notify your house manager if applicable. All notifications should be made well before your move date to ensure services transition correctly.

steps.title: Submit notification of move to DVV and Posti
steps.detail: You must notify the Digital and Population Data Services Agency (DVV) and Posti of your new address to ensure your information is updated in the Population Information System and your mail is delivered correctly.
steps.due: within a week of your move at the latest

steps.title: Terminate your current rental agreement
steps.detail: If you live in a rental dwelling, you must terminate your lease agreement in writing well in advance, usually giving one month's notice.

steps.title: Notify the house manager of your move
steps.detail: If you live in a block of flats or a terraced house, notify the house manager of your move so they can update your name on the door and resident list.

steps.title: Handle electricity contract for your move
steps.detail: Contact your energy company to terminate your old electricity contract and arrange a new one for your new address.

evidence.title: How to submit a notification of move - Moving and travelling - Suomi.fi
evidence.quote: However you must take care of that the notification has been received by the Digital and Population Data Services Agency within a week of your move at the latest.

evidence.title: InfoFinland - Moving house
evidence.quote: If you live in a rental dwelling, remember to give notice well in advance.

evidence.title: InfoFinland - Moving house
evidence.quote: If you live in a block of flats or in a terraced house, always remember to also notify the house manager (isännöitsijä) about your move.

evidence.title: InfoFinland - Moving house
evidence.quote: Terminate your old electricity contract before you move and make a new one.

openQuestions: Are you moving from a rental dwelling?
Do you live in a block of flats or terraced house?
Are you receiving any benefits from Kela, such as housing allowance or unemployment benefits?
